text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : VACCUME HARDENING HARDNESS & DEPTH : 59±2 HRc FINISH & DEPTH : IZBP"}],"comment":"Note N2 lists vacuum hardening and the IZBP finish but does not state the sequence (harden before or after plating), which is essential for process planning. The designer should add a note specifying that vacuum hardening is performed before the IZBP surface treatment.","recommended_correction":"Add wording to N2 such as 'VACUUM HARDEN BEFORE IZBP PLATING' to define the manufacturing sequence."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D33","page":1,"quote":"H7"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D36","page":1,"quote":"H7"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Holes F1 (D33) and F2 (D36) carry an H7 fit tolerance, yet the part receives an IZBP plating per the title block; no note indicates the plating thickness is allowed for or that holes are re-machined after coating. Plating buildup will reduce the bore size and can cause the intended H7 fit to fail in assembly. The designer should either open the pre-plate hole tolerances to compensate for the IZBP thickness or add a note requiring the holes to be finished to H7 after plating.","recommended_correction":"Specify pre-plate hole sizes that account for IZBP thickness, or add a note such as 'MACHINE H7 HOLES AFTER IZBP PLATING'."}]}
